======== test_andes_sim_memsize.sh ========
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# --mem-size contract: one model-neutral flag, per-model semantics.
#
#   fast:   forwards a plain `-m` only when given (QEMU as-is otherwise);
#           QEMU itself validates the 2 GiB AE350 DRAM window.
#   hybrid: sizes the shared mmap (= QEMU backend = vsim window); the driver
#           caps at 2G BEFORE allocating the backing file.
#   cycle:  validate-only (the engine always models its full DRAM window).
#   --mmap-size stays as a hidden alias of --mem-size.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/vplat_hello.elf"        # engine-portable (fast/cycle)
MELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf"        # carries ROI markers (hybrid)

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"
[ -f "$ELF" ] || fail "missing fixture: $ELF (make -C tests/fixtures)"
[ -f "$MELF" ] || fail "missing fixture: $MELF (make -C tests/fixtures)"

# 1. fast + --mem-size 1G: forwarded -m accepted, program still runs.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 1G "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast --mem-size 1G rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# F2 proof for the 2 GiB memory target: a hybrid run with --mem-size 2G,
# where phase 1 (QEMU) writes a pattern 4 KiB below the top of the 2 GiB
# AE350 DRAM window and the ROI (vsim) reads it back through the shared
# mmap. Passing means the whole stack -- driver cap, sparse backing file,
# QEMU memory backend, vsim RAM window -- agrees on 2 GiB end to end.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"

. "$ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null || true
GCC="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"
[ -x "$GCC" ] || { echo "SKIP: no riscv toolchain"; exit 0; }
[ -d "$ROOT/build/runtime" ] || { echo "SKIP: vplat runtime not built"; exit 0; }

TMP=$(mktemp -d -t mmap2g.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

cat > "$TMP/hi2g.c" <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <andesim/ROI.h>

/* 4 KiB below the 2 GiB AE350 DRAM window top. */
#define HI ((volatile uint64_t *)0x7FFFF000ull)

int main(void)
{
  HI[0] = 0x1122334455667788ull;   /* phase 1: QEMU writes near the top */
  HI[1] = 0xCAFEF00DDEADBEEFull;
  andesim_ROI_begin();
  /* ROI runs on vsim over the same mmap; vplat printf is MMIO-backed,
   * so reporting from inside the ROI is allowed. */
  uint64_t a = HI[0], b = HI[1];
  if (a == 0x1122334455667788ull && b == 0xCAFEF00DDEADBEEFull)
    printf("PASS: 2G window pattern survived the handoff\n");
  else
    printf("FAIL: high-memory pattern lost (a=%lx b=%lx)\n",
           (unsigned long)a, (unsigned long)b);
  andesim_ROI_end();
  return 0;
}
EOF

"$GCC" -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 \
  -I "$ROOT/build/runtime/include" \
  -B "$ROOT/build/runtime" -specs=andesim.specs \
  "$TMP/hi2g.c" -o "$TMP/hi2g.elf" \
  || fail "fixture build failed"

out=$("$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mem-size 2G "$TMP/hi2g.elf" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "hybrid --mem-size 2G rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[hsim mmap\] 2.0 GiB" \
  || fail "mmap status line should show 2.0 GiB:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "PASS: 2G window pattern survived the handoff" \
  || fail "high-memory pattern check did not pass:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "window_cycles" || fail "no cycle figure:"$'\n'"$out"
